notes.title: Update 1.2 - Deeper Challenges
notes.notes: [p]This update makes [i]PROTOCOL 11[/i] smoother and more challenging. Difficulty was increased with more enemies and reduced player health, and several bugs were fixed, including power-up activation, UI prompts, and odd character behavior. We also cleaned up unused upgrades and sprites, polished particles, and made various level improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Visuals have been enhanced with LBAO lighting, improved animations, and updated artwork. Audio has also been adjusted with fixes to breathing sounds. The demo is now re-enabled so new players can try the game before diving into the full experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's the changelog:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][i]Increased difficulty (more enemies, reduced player health)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Tweaked level design lighting, introducing LBAO (Light-Based Ambient Occlusion)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Improved animations and updated artwork[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Force jetpack to be given in levels after 4[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Improved particles for certain entities[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed issue where power-ups don’t activate with joystick[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed issue of some gamepad glyphs not appearing[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Added cooldown message when power-ups are activated[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Removed unused upgrades[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Changed text for the power-up (was “slow motion,” now “power-up module”)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed stuck “Press X to jump” message[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed icon getting stuck when reloading and switching to melee[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Replaced small area in level 4 (a box was causing the player to get stuck sometimes)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed Fita incorrect breathing sound[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed Phil facing direction issue on level 2’s ending[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Removed unused sprites[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed rendering issues on first person hand[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Re-enabled the demo[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Minor Level improvements[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Windows and MacOS builds are both updated.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and for all the support, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790"]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url="https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz"]Discord server[/url]![/p]

notes.title: 1.0 Version is finally here!
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 is here! 

We're excited to announce that our game is now out of Early Access! With this update, we've made many big and small changes, including cool new effects, improved character animations, fixed display issues, and new multiplayer levels and surprises for you to enjoy. Dive in and experience the definitive version!

Here's the changelog:

⦁	Fixed UI elements incorrectly affected by post processing
⦁	Added LUT and better bloom effects
⦁	Added classic blood effects
⦁	Robot companion now have expressions
⦁	Larvs now have more variations and pickup effects
⦁	Improved medic AI and VFX
⦁	Improved VFX on enemy robot spiders.
⦁	Controls can now be tweaked in-game.
⦁	Improved animation while using ladders.
⦁	Added 3 new multiplayer levels.
⦁	Updated glyphs for Xbox, Playstation and SteamDeck controllers.
⦁	Improved Main Menu's navigation.
⦁	Multiple level improvements.
⦁	Fixed resolution aspect for Macbooks and Steam Decks.
⦁	Replaced visual indicator of last known position
⦁	Added easter egg on level4.
⦁	Tweaked some face expressions for certain cut-scenes.

We've poured our hearts into this project for many years and we're so happy to have reached this milestone with all of you!

Windows and MacOS builds are both updated.

Thank you for your patience, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Patch notes EA 1.0.6 (aka: The Rushed Jetpack)
notes.notes:
We were forced to rush an update due issues on progression. Rolling this change back is additional work, so we pushed things as is. We are planning to improve the campfire experience, so players are now able to craft bandages. This needs to be explained better in a future update, but is okay enough for the time being.


[list]
[*] Fixed issue where players can't craft a Jetpack because they already got one.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kgc4o2V.png[/img]
[*] Players are now able to craft bandages. Hold V on keyboard, Dpad Down on gamepad. This will be explained better in the next update.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vpOktKk.png[/img]
[*] New resource type: cloth. Used to craft bandages. They can be looted from dead corpses (those already present in the world, not from kills)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gvP8WS1.png[/img]
[*] Fixed issues related to player speed.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Patch notes EA 1.0.5 (aka: Silent Firestarter)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Locator not being able to be picked up if touched angled surfaces.
[*] Removed screen shake for footsteps.
[*] Ammo boxes will have a light indicator for when are filled/empty.
[*] Made easier to pick drops.
[*] Fixed collision issues on level6.
[*] Fixed instances where player can shoot weapons while drawing.
[*] Fixed hostages "dissapearing". While not exactly a bug, they won't run away so players don't think it's a bug.
[*] Replaced zip lines for horizontal moving platforms, until we can come up with a better solution.
[*] Robot won't shoot enemies, when using a lookout, in stealth mode. This caused a few issues but is now fixed.
[*] Silencers are now more effective.
[*] Small level tweaks.
[/list]

Thanks [b]@Silentrets[/b] and [b]@firestarter109[/b] for helping out fixing issues. We fixed everything we can replicate, but for those very very very rare bugs we welcome any type of information to help us solve it.

We will keep squashing bugs and they always take priority. 

Also thanks to [b]@Widmer[/b] for helping out with concepts for Episode 2.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/kGbdqbv.jpeg][img]https://i.imgur.com/kGbdqbv.jpeg[/img][/url]

 [url=https://i.imgur.com/WscqS5c.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/WscqS5c.png[/img][/url]

As there's enough demand, we will focus on creating a[b] good campfire experience first[/b], but we will work on multiple languages and keyboard/gamepad rebinds in the future.

Thank you for your patience, please make sure to leave feedback & suggestions in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1099790]Steam Community Hub[/url] or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fTTM4jz]Discord server[/url] !

notes.title: Patch notes EA 1.0.3 (aka: The Magnetic x VanWol update)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Master and SFX sounds can now be changed properly in Options.
[*] Increased timer for Intro level.
[*] Fixed UI issues on pause menu.
[*] Improved takedowns.
[*] Tweaked UI to make more elements more readable/easy to understand.
[*] Fixed weapon firing while pressing dialog skip button.
[*] Fixed cut scene issues.
[*] Fixed small exploit where players could kill repelling enemies before they touch the ground.
[*] Fixed double jump issues on first levels.
[*] Reworked Bow Area so players can notice the weapon better.
[*] Fixed stealth kills animation/behaviour issues. Enemies will now detect players instantly, on later levels, when they come too close.
[*] Fixed issues when reloading.
[*] Increased range for melee weapons.
[*] Small tutorial for hacked robot.
[*] Adjusted level bounds.
[*] Small level tweaks.
[*] Made easier to loot wood components.
[*] Main character will clean its blood a bit when picks health. No longer "if you just want to get clean, just die".
[/list]

[b]Thanks to The Magnetic Cat and shout out to @VanWol[/b] for such comprehensive list of bugs. While not particulary game-breaking, is important to keep players frustration to a minimun. This is an ongoing work to have a very polished product that we, as developers, could be proud of.

Also thanks everyone for the continued support. Remember to let us know any bugs you may encounter!

We will continue towards Localization, for multiple language support and Keyboard/gamepad rebinds.
